world.title: Robbo fumes over contentious Bunker call in Roosters’ finals defeat
world.description:
Roosters coach Trent Robinson has taken aim at the officiating – and one call in particular – after his side’s 19-12 qualifying final loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
While the Roosters mentor agreed the Bunker was correct in deeming Hugo Savala guilty of double movement early in the second half, he argued his side should have been awarded a penalty for the crusher tackle Dylan Edwards made on the Tricolours playmaker in the same play.
